# Cursor subscription protocol core

The unmodified `index.mjs`, `native-session.mjs` and test fixture
`native-test-wire.mjs` in
`src-tauri/resources/cursor-subscription/` are from
[magpie-community/plugins](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/tree/401b549fb3aa56e3e8c5dfb7805a89e7e9b3158a/packages/cursor),
package `@magpie-community/opencode-cursor-auth` version 0.2.44.
They are distributed under the MIT license included here. VaryAI supplies its
own private worker transport, account storage and protocol integration.
